name: ML Engineer
tagline: Train, evaluate, and improve models — classical ML through transformers.
description: A model-centric path. You build the mathematical and machine-learning foundations properly, learn deep learning and training dynamics, then move through transformers, generative models, and LLM training. Agents and multi-agent systems are deprioritized: your value comes from model quality, evaluation, and training pipelines.

phaseRationale.15-autonomous-systems: Autonomous agent research is a different discipline from model development and does not improve training outcomes.
phaseRationale.16-multi-agent-and-swarms: Multi-agent orchestration does not contribute to model quality, which is the focus of this track.
phaseRationale.13-tools-and-protocols: Protocol engineering is valuable for product work but is not where model engineers spend their time.
phaseRationale.06-speech-and-audio: Audio modeling is a worthwhile specialization but optional for a general ML engineering foundation.
phaseRationale.12-multimodal-ai: Multimodal model internals are deep research territory and optional for this track.

majorProjects: End-to-end fine-tuning pipeline (data → SFT → DPO → serve)
Mini GPT pre-training and evaluation harness
